0xB10C:

My understanding from Enable `-natpmp` by default by darosior · Pull Request #33004 · bitcoin/bitcoin · GitHub is that we made this default ON as we want more/all nodes accept inbound connections.

To be clear, that feature defaulting to on also makes goal 2 worse, as far as I can see. I think we haven’t seen much increased reachability as a result of that change, so I guess I’m thinking about that goal as something of a revealed preference from Bitcoin users, and seeing if it seems rational after the fact.

It probably makes sense to rerun these numbers to see if things changed now. However, I’m not sure it’s fair to come to the conclusion that Bitcoin users prefer their home nodes to be unreachable. Checking if more reachable nodes in ISPs vs cloud show up measures router and ISP compatibility and not user consent or preference.
